question: What attributes of the goddess are affirmed when the worshipper declares worship of her threefold form?
premises: The goddess is worshipped by the three worlds.
The goddess has a threefold form.
The speaker declares worship of her.
inference: The worshipper worships the three-formed goddess who is adored by the three worlds.
plain_english: I worship the goddess of three forms, who is worshipped by the three worlds.
